desc: A body moving in frame - sitting, turning, reaching, putting on a coat.
prompt: a heavy canvas coat being pulled on and shifted, fabric dragging over fabric, a soft rustle and one sharp flap as a sleeve is pulled through, close microphone, dry, quiet
note: The smallest bed here and the one that does the most work - a body that makes fabric noise reads as physically present even in a shot where nothing else changes. Sit it 12-18 dB under dialogue; if you can consciously hear it, it is too loud and starts sounding like a separate event.
